Teacher Curriculum · Grades 11–12

Precalculus

Explore advanced mathematical relationships, trigonometry, functions, and mathematical modeling through the physics and geometry of mountain biking.

4 quarters · 9 units · 41 topics · 9 lesson plans ready

Proposed sequence This quarter-by-quarter order is Mathlete MTB’s suggested pacing for a typical school year, not a school’s confirmed calendar. Your school’s order may differ; every lesson stands on its own.

Quarter 1 Aug – Oct Plans coming Quarter 2 Nov – Jan · Now 9 lesson plans Quarter 3 Jan – Mar Plans coming Quarter 4 Apr – Jun Plans coming
